commits.author: Marco Andronaco
commits.subject: fix: keep pinned to latest message while opening a session
commits.body:
The existing auto-scroll ran once messages loaded, but tool/diff parts
fetch their content asynchronously and grow the message list's height
afterward, leaving the view scrolled above the true bottom. Pin to
bottom via a ResizeObserver for a couple seconds after opening a
session so it tracks that late layout growth.

commits.author: Marco Andronaco
commits.subject: feat: let the user answer the assistant's AskUserQuestion prompts
commits.body:
When the assistant calls the question tool, the server holds a
pending QuestionRequest (GET /question) until it's answered via
POST /question/{id}/reply or rejected via .../reject. Previously
these had no UI representation at all, so a question from the
assistant would silently stall the session.

Now pending questions for the open session are loaded alongside
messages/todos/diff, refreshed on question.asked/replied/rejected
events, and rendered as an interactive card (options, multi-select,
optional free-text "Other…") right in the conversation, with Send/Skip
actions that call the reply/reject endpoints.

commits.author: Marco Andronaco
commits.subject: fix: stop the periodic message refresh from wiping streamed reasoning
commits.body:
GET /session/{id}/message doesn't return reasoning parts, only the
live event stream does. The debounced full refresh (which fires
whenever new text streams in) was replacing the whole messages array
wholesale, so any reasoning text that had just streamed in via
message.part.updated/delta vanished the moment the refresh landed.

mergeFetchedMessages now carries over reasoning parts the refetch
doesn't know about instead of dropping them.

commits.author: Marco Andronaco
commits.subject: fix: never let a reasoning update shrink already-shown thinking text
commits.body:
The previous fix only covered the periodic REST refetch dropping
reasoning parts entirely. Reports show the Thinking block still gets
replaced mid-stream, which points to a live message.part.updated
snapshot arriving with shorter/reset text for the same part id.

reconcileReasoningPart now keeps whichever version of a reasoning
part's text is longer, applied both to live part updates and the
periodic refetch merge, so a stray shorter/empty snapshot can no
longer visibly erase what's already streamed in.
